# Six Pixel

> Six Pixel is a Toronto customer-growth studio for local businesses. It audits how customers find a business today — website, Google search (SEO), AI assistants (GEO) and Google Maps — fixes what is losing customers, and keeps new ones coming with social media content and short promo videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

- Area served: Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (Ontario, Canada).
- Who it is for: auto repair shops, furniture and home retailers, restaurants and cafés, bakeries, salons, clinics and home-service trades.
- Contact: jasonliu97424@gmail.com
- Starting point: a free growth check, followed by a fixed quote. Optional monthly plans, no long contracts.

## The growth audit (six areas)

1. Website: mobile speed, clear services/prices/products, working calls, booking and checkout.
2. Search (SEO): current and target rankings, on-page fixes.
3. AI search (GEO): how ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews describe the business; facts, FAQs and structured data they need.
4. Google Maps: Business Profile categories, services, photos, hours, posts; consistent listings.
5. Reviews & reputation: rating, volume, recency, replies, review requests.
6. Social & video: which channels matter, what to post, how often.

## Services

- Fix the foundations: website speed, accessibility, booking/quote/order flows, on-page SEO, analytics.
- Get found on Maps & AI: Google Business Profile optimization, directory consistency, LocalBusiness/Product schema, llms.txt and AI-readable FAQs.
- Grow with social & video: monthly content plans, short vertical promo videos, ad-ready creatives, monthly results report. Videos are human-reviewed and posted only with approval.

## Demo sites (fictional businesses)

- [Torque & Tread Auto](https://xuanchen97.github.io/sixpixel-studio/demos/auto/): auto repair — price ranges, online booking, seasonal promo video.
- [Oak & Ash Home](https://xuanchen97.github.io/sixpixel-studio/demos/furniture/): furniture showroom — product listings, sale prices, room filters, delivery info, sale video.
- [Lantern Lane Dumplings](https://xuanchen97.github.io/sixpixel-studio/demos/lantern/): counter-service restaurant — online ordering, dietary filters, promo reel.
- [Saltwick Kitchen](https://xuanchen97.github.io/sixpixel-studio/demos/saltwick/): bistro — reservations, weekly menu, private dining, promo reel.
- [Fernwood Bakehouse](https://xuanchen97.github.io/sixpixel-studio/demos/fernwood/): bakery — live bake schedule, cake pre-orders, allergen table, promo reel.
